audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 for Leona matches a poke mage who out-ranges her engage until items — content layer already tells this story correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart (phases[0-6].side) reads 'Skill' on every row while content win[0-6] already reads Vel'Koz on every row and the packet levelChart agrees with content — the two layers of the SAME chart contradict each other on all 7 rows, and every phases[].why is a Leona-favoured template that argues the opposite of what win[N]/whys[N] say.
audit.why: Vel'Koz's split Q (7s cd) and W (1.5s cd) poke Leona off approach before Level 3, his E (12-10s cd) interrupts Zenith Blade on cooldown, and his channelled R with 3-stack true damage punishes her commit — the packet's all-Vel'Koz chart and the content whys already document this correctly; only phases[].side/why were left on the stale Skill template.
audit.corrected: Move phases[0-6].side to Vel'Koz and rewrite each .why to the real reason (poke range, E interrupt, true-damage stacking, channel execute), matching win[N] which is already correct — no win[N] edit needed since it already reads Vel'Koz.

audit.why: Content layer already documents the real interactions: E (Tectonic Disruption) interrupts the dash, true damage from Organic Deconstruction bypasses resistances, and the R channel is cancellable by Solar Flare.

edits.before: Auto-trade behind passive marks — your carry's follow-up hits harder than the lane reads.
edits.after: He splits Plasma Fission (Q) through minions and shoves with Void Rift (W) — you can't reach him without eating a full poke rotation first.

edits.before: E-Q online — the chain is live and the lane's geometry answers to your blade.
edits.after: Level-2 Q-plus-W burst punishes your engage harder than your point-and-click passive rewards it, and his E isn't even online yet.

edits.before: Full chain: E-Q-W locks a carry for the full duo rotation; pick the window.
edits.after: Tectonic Disruption (E, 12s cd at rank 1) comes online and interrupts Zenith Blade mid-dash, resetting the trade in his favor.

edits.before: Zone with chain threat — their carry farms where your E says.
edits.after: Three stacks of Organic Deconstruction convert his poke into true damage that ignores your resistances, so his chip outpaces your sustain.

edits.before: Solar Flare online — dives start from two screens and the sun votes center-stun.
edits.after: Life Form Disintegration Ray (R) is a channelled execute that reads your engage — if his Q slow lands first, you eat the full beam before Solar Flare arrives.

edits.before: First item: the chain hardens and every landed E is a kill.
edits.after: His first poke component turns Organic Deconstruction into consistent true-damage procs, zoning you off the lane before you find a clean Zenith Blade angle.

edits.before: Late Leona starts everything: flare the entry, chain the carry, eclipse the answer.
edits.after: He scales into a one-rotation teamfight burster; you stay reactive until a tank item lets you eat the channel and lock him with Solar Flare.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: His Q (Plasma Fission, cd 7s) reaches 1050 — hug fog at max range so the split-Q slow never touches your dash.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Void Rift (W) is back up in 1.5s — trading auto-for-auto just feeds him another poke window for free.

edits.before: - Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption: matchup-defining — The knockup starts the true-damage rotation — dodge it and the research stalls. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Eclipse banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Vel'Koz's E (Tectonic Disruption) is up every 12s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5 — it interrupts your dash on cooldown, so track it before every engage. - His R resets in 100s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3 — that gap is your engage window. - Keep W Eclipse banked for his E-into-R combo.

notes: Main fix: phases[0-6].side was stuck on the 'Skill' template while content win[0-6] already correctly reads Vel'Koz on every row (matches packet.levelChart) — moved side to Vel'Koz and rewrote each why from the kit; win[N] needed no edit since it already matched the target side. Also fixed both COPY_PASTE_BLEED lint findings and the COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT finding with real E/R cooldown numbers.
